paite: Huan Samuel asita a; Israel mi tengteng ahong paikhawm ua, amah kah in Ramah ah a-inn uah avui uhi. David athou a Paran gamdai ah ahohsuk hi.
heading: Samuel Sihna

paite: Maon ah mi khat a-om a, Karmel tang ah aneih-le-lam a-om hi. Amah mithupitak ahi a, belam sangthum leh kel sangkhat anei hi. Karmel tang ah abelam mul amet hi.
heading: David Leh Abigail

paite: Amin Nabal ahi a, azi min Abigail ahi. Huai numei teitak leh melhoihtak ahi. Himahleh pasal pen mi chihhaktak leh giloutak ahi a; amah Kaleb suan ahi.
David in gamdai a pan Nabal in abelam mul amet chih ana za hi.
Huchi in David in tangval sawm asawl a, tangvalte kiang ah, "David in Karmel tang ah va hohtou unla, Nabal kiang ah hoh unla ka min in chibai va buk un.
Mineizoupa kiang ah huchi in va chi un: 'Nang tung ah, na inkuante tung ah leh na neih tengteng tung ah khamuanna om hen.
Na belam mulmet mite a-om uh chih ka na za hi. Na belamching mite ka kiang ah a-om zel ua, apoi uh bangmah ka khoih kei ua, Karmel tang a a-om sung un bangmah amangsak kei uh.

Na tangvalte dong lechin hon hilh mai ding uh. Huchi in hiai ka tangvalte'n na mitmuh in deihsakna tang uhen, ni hoih ni tak a hong hoh lah ka hi ngal ua. Na neih bangbang na sikhate leh na tapa David na pe dih ve, achi, chi un, " achi hi.
David tangvalte ava tun un David min in huai thu tengteng Nabal kiang ah agen ua, huchi in adaita uh.
Nabal in David sikhate adawng a, "David kua ahia oi? Jesse tapa kua ahia oi? Tulai in sikha tampi pute taimangsan atam mai uh.
Ka tanghou, ka tui leh ka belam mulmet mite a dia ka gohsa kuate ahi ua chih ka theihlouhte ka pe peuhmah dia hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in David tangvalte akihei ua, akik nawn ua; huai thu tengteng ahong hilh uh.
David in amite kiang ah, "Na namsau uh kuah chiat un," achi hi. Anamsau uh akuah chiat uh. David in leng anamsau akuah a, mi zali in David azuitou ua; mi zanih van veng in a-om uhi.
Tangval khat in Nabal zi Abigail kiang ah, "Ngai in, David in gamdai a pan ka pu uh chibai buk ding in mi ahon sawl a, ama'n ana sal hi.
Himahleh huaite lah ka tung uah ahoih mahmah ua, ka poi uh bangmah akhoih kei uh. Gamlak a ka om lai ua ka omkhawm sung tengteng uh bangmah ka tan kei uhi.
Belamching a akiang ua ka om sung tengteng un sun leh zan kou a ding in baang ahi mai uhi.

Huaiziak in bang ahia na hih ding hoihtak in ngaihtuah dih ve. Ka pu uh tung ah leh a-inkuan tengteng tung ah thil hoih lou tup in anei hi. Amah lah a Belial tapa mahmah a, kuamah houpih theih ahi kei hi," chi in agen hi.
Abigail in kintak in tanghou beu zanih, uain thawl nih, belam nga huan dia mansa, vaimim kan buk nga, grep gah phoukeu bawk zakhat leh theipi beu zanih alakhawm a, sabiltung aposak hi.
Asikha tangvalte kiang ah, "Ka ma ah na pai zel unla, ngai un, ka hon zui ding," achi hi. Himahleh apasal Nabal ahilh kei hi.
Huchi in hichibang ahi a, asabiltung tung a tuang a tang sang sing lak a apaisuk lai in, ngai in, David leh amite'n ahon zuan ua, huchi in amau atuakta hi.
David in, "Bangmah amansaklouhna dia gamdai a hiai mipa neih tengteng athawn lel in ka na vensak ana hi mahmah ve; thil hoih lah thil hoih lou in ahon dinta ngal a.
Zingchiang zingsang khovak pha a amah a tengteng lak a pasal naupang khat kia lel leng ka hawi peuhmahleh Pathian in David melmate thupizaw sem in bawl hen,” achi hi.
Abigail in David amuh in asabiltung a pan akumsuk zok a, David ma a lei si in akunsuk hi.
Akhebul ah abokkhup a, "Keimah in, ka toupa aw, kei mahmah in thulimlouhna ka khu ding. Na sikhanu'n na bil a zak ding in thu gen henla, na sikhanu thugen hehpih in ngaikhia in.
Ka toupa aw, Belial mi Nabal bangmah in sim ke'n. Amin bangbang ahi geih hi. Nabal ahi na mah a, ahai hi. Kei na sikhanu'n, ka toupa'n na hon sawl tangvalte ka na mu kha kei hi.

Huaiziak in tu in, toupa aw, TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi. Ka mu mahmah kei hi, TOUPA'N sisan suah lou ding leh na khut a phu la lou ding in lah nang ahon bawl hi. Na melmate leh ka toupa hoihlouhna zong mite Nabal bang himai uhen.
Hiai ka toupa a dia na sikha in vualzawlnate ka hon tawi ka pu hon zui tangvalte piak hi hen.
Na sikhanu tatlekna hehpih in ngaidam in. TOUPA'N ka toupa inkuan kiptak in aphut ngeingei dia, ka pu TOUPA kidounate dou ahi ngal a. Na damsung teng in nangmah gitlouh man muh ding a-om kei ding.

Nang hon delh ding leh na hinna hihmang ding in mite hong kisa mah le uh, ka toupa hinna zaw TOUPA na Pathian toh hinna a gak ahi dia; na melmate hinna bel vaisuanglot a suanglot bang in alawnmang ding hi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N na tungtang thu a thil hoih a chiam bang teng ka toupa tung a ahih chiang a, Israelte kumpipa dia ahon bawl chiang in,

Aziak om lou a sisan na suah louh a, ka toupa'n phu na lak louh nang a ding in lungkhamna himhim ahi kei ding. Ka toupa a ding in leng lungkimlouhna himhim ahi sam kei ding. TOUPA'N ka toupa tung a thil hoih ahih hun chiang in na sikhanu theigige in," achi hi.
David in Abigail kiang ah, "Tuni a kei hon na dawn dia hon sawlpa TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian phat in om hen.
Na lemtheihna vualzawl in om henla, nang sisan suah mohna a pan hon humnu leh keimah khut a phu la lou dia hon bawlnu vualzawl in om hen.
Kei hon dawn dia hong pawtkhe pah lou hi lechin, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi, zingchiang khovak pha in Nabal ka hawisak het kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in David in athiltawite ala a, akiang ah, "Lungmuangtak in na inn ah paitouta in. Na thu ka mang hi. Na nget nen ka hon sansak hi,” achi hi.

Nabal kiang ah Abigail ahohtou hi. Ngai in, a-inn ah kumpipa ankuanglui bang mai in ankuang a na lui hi. Akham mahmah ziak in Nabal amaitai ngial hi. Huaiziak in azingsang khovak masiah bangmah ahilh kei hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, zinglam a Nabal uain kham ahong halh in azi in huai thute ahilhta a, alung adaiduak a, suang bang in ahong om hial hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni sawm nung in TOUPA'N Nabal tung ah khut akha a, asita hi.

David in Nabal asi chih azak in, "Ka minsiatna dia Nabal thilhih a pan hon genpih a, asikha thil hoih lou hih lou dia hon khampa TOUPA phat in om hen. Nabal thil hoih lou hih TOUPA'N amah tung mah ah akesakta," achi hi. Huchi in David in Abigail azi dia va houpih ding in mi asawl hi.
David sikhate'n Karmel tang a Abigail kiang atuntouh un, "David in azi dia nang hong pi ding in ahon sawl," chi in amah ahoupih uhi.
Athou a, amai a lei si in akunsuk hi. "Ngai dih ua, na sikhanu uh ka toupa sikhate khe sil ding sikha ka hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Abigail athou zok a, sabiltung tung ah atuang a, anungzui nungak ngate toh David misawlte azui ua, azi in a-omta hi.
David in Jezreel a mi Ahinoam leng ana pi khin a; huchi in azi ding in a-om tuaktuak uhi.
Saul in lah atanu Mikal, David zi Gallim a mi Laish tapa Palti toh ana kitengsak zouta hi.
